notes: Authored from public requirements before the first run. Freeze for first-use holdout; after inspection or tuning these become regression cases, not fresh holdout. No independent human review yet.

environment.execution: local CPU Ollama, one concurrent inference
environment.costNotes: No paid model API was called. Tokens are not exposed by the assistant API; hardware/electricity cost is unmeasured.

policyComparison.notes: End-to-end fact selection accuracy on positive policy questions; simple accent-normalized token overlap, not BM25. Application includes retrieval and the relevance gate, so this is not isolated retrieval Recall@k.

releaseGate.notes: Gate set before first evaluation run: all cases completed; >=80% overall and policy/unknown/availability case pass rates; zero critical failures and verified cleanup. Not a universal security guarantee.

latency.notes: Sequential mixed correctness workload on this CPU; not a load benchmark. Backend duration excludes the independent live-slot verification.

retrievalComparison.notes: Independent real EmbeddingGemma 768-dimension queries and exact pgvector cosine ranking filtered by corpus version. Token overlap is not BM25. This is retrieval evidence separate from final answer relevance.
